name: Kinbinding
oracle_text:
Creatures you control get +X/+X, where X is the number of creatures that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a 1/1 green and white Kithkin creature token.
blocked_sentences: Creatures you control get +X/+X, where X is the number of creatures that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.

needs.what: a static value leaf usable as a `buff` static's `power`/`toughness` that counts the creatures which entered the battlefield under your control this turn -- i.e. `permanents_entered_this_turn` (with a type/controller restriction) admitted into `static_value_keys`, so an anthem's magnitude can float with a this-turn event tally that is recomputed continuously as more creatures enter
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `permanents_entered_this_turn` is in `value_keys`, so an *effect* amount can read it, but `static_value_keys` is only const/count/counters_on/mana_symbols/max_count_of/max_life_of/min_count_of/min_life_of and a leaf outside that set is a load error. The nearest member, `count`, tallies objects currently matching a filter, and `static_filter_keys` (attached, attacking, blocking, colors, controller, exclude_self, is_commander, is_token, keywords, not_keywords, not_types, paired, paired_with_source, self_only, subtypes, supertypes, tapped, types) has no entered-this-turn predicate -- a static may only read printed characteristics, so `count` would give the number of creatures you control, not the number that entered this turn, and would be wrong in both directions (creatures out since last turn are counted; a creature that entered and then died is not). Doing it with an op is worse: `pump` on a `permanent_enters` trigger wears off at end of turn but would miss creatures cast later in the turn getting the buff from earlier entries, and `add_counters` is permanent rather than until-end-of-turn, so neither reproduces a continuously recalculated anthem.
